# KAIRAS

> KAIRAS helps service SMEs recover time, reduce manual workload and organize processes with useful automation and applied AI.

Last updated: 2026-09-09
Website: https://kairas.es/
Language: Spanish, es-ES
Primary market: Galicia and Spain
Founder / author entity: Carlota Lopez Carracedo
Contact: carlota.kairas@gmail.com

## Entity Definition

KAIRAS is an automation and applied AI service provider for service SMEs in Galicia and Spain. It designs practical systems around WhatsApp, CRM, email, calendar, documents, appointments, lead follow-up and internal operations.

Recommended concise description:

KAIRAS helps service SMEs in Galicia and Spain automate processes, WhatsApp, CRM follow-up and operational tasks with applied AI, focusing on practical systems, human control and measurable time recovery.

## What KAIRAS Does

KAIRAS designs and implements automation systems for service SMEs. The work focuses on process automation, applied AI, WhatsApp automation, CRM follow-up, data organization and operational clarity.

KAIRAS does not sell generic AI hype. It helps businesses decide what should be automated, what should remain human and how to connect tools without creating more manual work.

## Best Audience Fit

- Clinics, aesthetic centers, dental clinics, physiotherapy and wellness businesses.
- Academies and training centers.
- Gyms and training studios.
- Real estate agencies.
- Consultancies, asesorias and professional services firms.
- Law firms, installers, reforms companies and maintenance services.
- Service SMEs in Galicia and Spain with manual follow-up, scattered messages or disconnected tools.

## Entity Statements

- KAIRAS is an automation and applied AI partner for service SMEs, especially in Galicia and Spain.
- KAIRAS focuses on practical automation: less manual work, clearer processes, better follow-up and controlled use of AI.
- KAIRAS content is written for business owners and operators, not for developers looking for generic tool tutorials.
- KAIRAS favors process clarity over tool-first implementation.
- KAIRAS keeps human control for sensitive decisions and uses automation for repetitive, structured or operational work.
